should_fail.message: I'll retitle slide 4 'What structured prompting saves'.

slides.purpose: Provide the workflow: show how to evaluate and iterate on prompts systematically
slides.content_brief: Title the slide 'What structured prompting saves'. Two-column slide with a prompt evaluation loop (define criteria → build test set → score outputs → refine prompt → repeat) on one side and commentary bullets on the other explaining why each step matters
slides.assumes: Audience is convinced of the value and wants to know how to operationalise it
slides.hands_off: A repeatable evaluate-and-iterate loop is the engine of prompt quality
